description: Server-side accept/reject classification of the first WS frame on /ext-api/mse_stream. Mirrors inference_service/worker_server.py handshake handling. A conforming server (main_service/worker) MUST classify each `input` to the given `expect`. A conforming client MUST only ever send frames that classify as accept:true.
